doc.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Seeing Thelonious Monk at the University of Rochester
summary: Flanigan recalls hearing Monk in concert at U of R, the only time he saw him.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Right. Did you get into Rochester much as a kid, fairly close, to hear any music in there? You wound up going to Eastman, right?
I heard Monk at U of R.

Yeah. That’s the only time I saw Monk, and it’s the only time I saw a concert at U of R. I thought it was great. I think it was probably 1972 or something like that, or maybe a tad earlier. But I can at least say I saw Monk. I mean there’s a lot of other guys, having been born when I was, that I never did get a chance to see.
